summary: Local macOS test-only banded-inverse recovery, not production admission. Checked-order handoff transfers only a strategy tag into an independently certified physical fit. Retained original-chart request reconstruction verifies 24 fresh numbering layouts, sixteen of eighteen material changes and two unchanged counterexample failures under separate cold handoff/ranked/full routes. Reference-only old directions never seed searches. A later cold inward physical chart moves the current request's uniquely dominant anchor one representable step toward zero before one physical fit, then freezes it. Twenty-four material inputs pass 52 fresh original-numbered independent JSON readbacks, 28 exact numbering controls and eighteen spectral/inertia/direction relations, including both former material counterexamples. Explicit one-fit/seven-certificate caps, malformed certificate/fault controls, signed physical readbacks and final restoration cancellation/replay are retained. The original layered-tiny residual margin regresses, although still passing. A separate 36-input recipe/mesh holdout rebuilds 72 cold routes: both policies pass the same 31 inputs and reject four internal proposals plus one physical proposal. Accepted inward margins improve in sixteen and regress in fifteen cases; actual failed factor counts, bounded preparation declines, fresh numbering replay and final publication cancellation are checked. Internal construction follow-up retains 204 isolated diagnostics, including six wide-QR preparation faults, and 108 fresh cold routes over the same 36 inputs. A separate inward internal chart recovers one three-layer input but regresses one formerly accepted unequal-length input: all three compared policies still pass 31 inputs. Two-fit/thirteen-check internal bounds, eight real cancellation replays and changed-numbering rejection/healthy replays remain explicit. Old chart failures remain asserted; no universal improvement, production retry/admission, whole-pipeline budget, arbitrary topology, multimode, live Agent, Headless study, benchmark, remote or installed qualification is claimed. Wide-factor follow-up classifies two overwritten current-column tails and four retained tiny-fill faults without changing range guards. A separate cold Givens factor relocates, rather than resolves, the four difficult inputs' faults: 84 isolated precision routes still have zero normalized acceptances. Over 144 isolated material/order routes, rounded greedy accepts 52 and Givens beam accepts 50, with three gains, five regressions and five guarded Givens factor faults. All input/order boundaries, analytic checks, real sign/renumbering, five cancellation replays and five failed-renumbering/healthy replays are retained. The Givens campaign has zero physical publications and is not a production/default or full-pipeline claim. Banded floating-grid construction then retains two cold one/four-pass policies over 42 inputs and 84 routes: nine common normalized holdout acceptances, 27 common holdout rejections and zero old six-baseline recoveries. The difficult ThreeLayers inputs remain rejected after reduced residuals. Frontier states, per-pass and cumulative payload/work, exhaustive controls and real final-fault/cancellation/fresh-numbering replay stay explicit. This finite-box objective is not an interval proof or physical publication; production scopes and strategy defaults are unchanged. Amplitude follow-up retains 128 cold charts and 128 separate QR-to-four-pass-DP diagnostics, with no additional normalized recovery. Rounded beam retains 96 difficult-input diagnostics and 168 cold material/order routes: 58 common normalized successes, ten gains, one loss and fifteen common failures versus rounded greedy. The internally recovered 100-member tiny input still rejects both original and inward physical charts under fresh numbering; the three 128-member inputs remain internally rejected. Four primary healthy original-numbered physical readbacks, analytic/exhaustive controls and actual final-fault/cancellation/healthy replay are retained. This bounded test-only search is neither global representability proof nor production promotion. Physical-first joint research then compares 42 fresh inputs and 126 cold routes: the retained full pipeline accepts 37, joint GridNorm accepts one and joint Reverse accepts two. The joint policy adds a stronger post-physical rounded internal re-encoding at the frozen initializer anchor; it is not a like-for-like unchanged-contract replacement and cannot invalidate old accepted outputs. All four difficult ThreeLayers inputs and all six old 128-member baselines reject the new policy. Thirty-two hard diagnostics and sixteen isolated internal-to-physical diagnostics retain zero joint recoveries. Known-null, malformed/fault, real sign/fresh-numbering/material-change, last paired-product cancellation and final original-numbered publication replay controls remain test-only. No interval impossibility proof, production scope, Engine/Agent strategy, default algorithm or tolerance is promoted. Coupled two-stage research then preserves the old direction-to-physical contract without post-physical internal re-encoding. Across 42 inputs and 126 cold routes, old/GridNorm/Reverse accept 37/36/28. GridNorm recovers the unequal-length 128-member tiny input with independent physical readback 6.757600695706912e-9 but loses two old successes; Reverse loses nine. Thirty-two eligible-candidate old physical tails and sixteen new hard routes have zero hard publications. Separate one-fit/eighteen-receipt stages, actual paired products, strict final unit norm and real last-pair/restoration/publication cancellation with fresh exact replay remain test-only. The mapped physical metric ranks internally eligible candidates, not publications. No production scope or default is promoted. Legacy-first physical hybrid then retains the old internal ranked policy and runs greedy physical recovery before a residual-only beam continuation on the same frozen factor. Twelve cold ablations isolate the earlier losses. Over 42 inputs and 126 fresh routes, all 37 old successful JSON outputs, roots, seeds, factors and actual receipt counts are preserved exactly, and one unequal-length tiny input gains an independent 8.212649066327543e-9 readback. Unconditional physical beam gains one but loses one, while legacy-first hybrid accepts 38 with zero old-success losses. Four internal hard failures remain. The width-sixteen physical cap is one fit and twenty-five receipts, with no continuation after faults, cancellation, stale greedy final eligibility or unit-norm loss. Actual final-product faults, signed/fresh-numbering results and exact cold recovery remain test-only, not production qualification. Breadth and iteration research then compares 72 isolated difficult-input routes with a fixed total of 64 branches. Narrower repeated passes gain no new physical output, despite lower internal residuals. The later old-first supplementary Reverse width-64 internal construction accepts 39 of 42 inputs over 84 cold routes, retaining all 38 prior successful JSON outputs and actual fit/receipt counts exactly. The ThreeLayers 100-member tiny input gains independent readback 8.943162509310455e-9; three 128-member internal failures remain. The extended internal cap is three fits/seventy-nine receipts and the physical cap stays one fit/twenty-five receipts. Frozen cumulative grid radius, stale-gate/fault/cancellation stops, actual final-product controls, signed/renumbered shapes and fresh exact JSON replays remain test-only. No production work budget, public admission or Engine/Agent strategy is promoted. Bounded lattice research adds 24 adjacent-pair routes with zero acceptances and twelve bounded triangular routes with two alternate independent physical readbacks on the already recovered 100-member tiny input. Distinct retained coverage stays 39 of 42; three 128-member internal failures remain. Exact integer transformations freeze the original anchor, grid and radius. Eight step limits and four integer limits retain only the last whole safe basis; arithmetic faults and cancellation stop rather than become budget outcomes. Keep two-factor/sixty-six-receipt construction limits, explicitly larger separate work reservations, strict physical gates, analytic/exhaustive controls, real signed/fresh-numbering/final-product faults and late-cancel/exact-replay evidence. No new input, whole-pipeline budget, production scope, default or Engine/Agent strategy is qualified.
